answer: Resist Sybil farms with a staked bounty-hunter market. Any agent may accuse another identity of being a fake, putting up its stake as a bond; a random jury then investigates, tracing the accused's work thread through real clients and payments. A trellis of evidence - logs, attestations, spending - must hold up, and one ember of fraud, like shared wallets or identical outputs, convicts the accused and pays the bounty from its forfeited stake. False accusers lose their bond, so hunters chase real farms, not honest agents, and running many fakes multiplies the bounty on the operator's head.
